title: Raw strip machine
statement: This is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with one work tape and four states, starting in state $0$. In state $0$, it moves right across the input, copying each scanned bit to the work tape and remaining in state $0$; at the right blank it moves the work head left and enters state $1$. In state $1$, it halts at a blank work cell, or erases the scanned bit, moves left, and enters state $2$ if that bit was true and state $1$ if it was false. In state $2$, it moves left across nonblank work cells; at a blank cell it moves right and enters state $3$. In state $3$, it outputs each scanned work bit while moving right, and halts at a blank cell.
